about.description: gTrade is a decentralized leveraged-trading platform launched in 2021 by Gains Network, the multichain perpetuals project founded by pseudonymous developer Seb on Polygon and now deployed across Arbitrum, Polygon, and Base. It supports 130+ pairs spanning crypto, stocks, equity indices, commodities, and forex with multi-collateral margining (USDC, DAI, WETH) and integrates Chainlink CCIP & Data Streams alongside Pyth for cross-chain liquidity and pricing. The protocol is governed via the GNS token and is one of the longest-running on-chain perpetual venues for traditional-asset markets, with a track record of guaranteed order execution and one-click trading.
about.registryInfo: Gains Network was founded in 2021 by pseudonymous founder Seb (full-stack developer), later joined by Nathan, Lunaman, Crumb, and additional contributors. The protocol is governed via the GNS token and the Gains Network DAO; gTrade is the protocol's flagship perpetual product and integrates Chainlink CCIP, Chainlink Data Streams, and Pyth for cross-chain liquidity and pricing.

fees.revenueNotes: gTrade RWA fee model is spread-based, not maker/taker. Fixed 1 bp spread on major and minor forex pairs and on tier-1 commodities. Per-pair spreads on exotic FX and lower-tier commodities (vary by volatility). Stocks/equities use dynamic spread via price-impact formula. Spread never applies at closing — only at opening. Borrowing fees apply to open positions. Crypto markets (not on this RWA page) have 0% spread on BTC/ETH and dynamic spread on alts. Fee distribution: 22% governance (DAO), 15% LP vault, 54% GNS token burn, 5% referrals, 4% trigger keepers. Source: https://docs.gains.trade/gtrade-leveraged-trading/fees-and-spread
